summary: Coos FPA lookout on Coos Mountain, staffed 1925-1958; build, tower and removal dates conflict across sources (removed 1959 or abandoned 1962); site today undocumented.

facts.design: 10' treated timber tower with an L-4 lookout house
facts.status_note: Removed; the register says removed in 1959, firelookout.com says destroyed in 1959, Forest Lookouts says abandoned in 1962

staffing.status: Seasonal lookouts named in the sources from 1928 to 1958

Forest Lookouts says 'The lookout abandoned.' in 1962; it gives no removal date

corrections.proposed: 10' treated timber tower with an L-4 lookout house
corrections.why: In the 1934 Forest Lookouts item, R-6 is part of the house plan name 'R-6 Revised Plan No. L-4', not a tower design; the register describes the tower as a 10' treated timber L-4 tower.

corrections.proposed: remove unless a source confirms 50 ft
corrections.why: No source confirms a 50-foot tower. The register and Forest Lookouts describe a 10-foot treated timber tower; the only 40-to-50-foot figure is a 1934 suggestion.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the first live-in tower to 1935. Forest Lookouts reports a 1934 packing of a house and an April 1936 new tower. Both are recorded in the events; neither is confirmed by a third source.

The register says the tower was removed in 1959; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1959. Forest Lookouts says the lookout was abandoned in 1962 and gives no removal date. Both are recorded; no third source settles it.

notes_for_editor: Two timelines conflict: build (1935 vs 1936), tower replacement (1946 vs 1957), and removal (1959 vs 1962). Brief's design R-6 and height 15.2 m look unsupported. No source describes the site today, so the story says so. Next steps if wanted: a 1950s photo, a removal note, or a county history.
